scope: Input authority and interface only. This does not select a production provider, validate conduction sufficiency, generate a profile, or authorize state materialization.

required_inputs.name: native_support_identity
required_inputs.authority: B-v2 canonical candidate cell IDs and source lineage
required_inputs.rule: exact native cell IDs; unknown or unsupported cells are rejected, not imputed

required_inputs.name: physical_domain_and_thermal_class
required_inputs.rule: categorical join only; do not interpolate IDs or infer composition

required_inputs.name: column_geometry
required_inputs.authority: crustal_thickness_m and applicable authored total model thickness or HWR column geometry
required_inputs.rule: preserve datum and source field identity; positive layer residual required; model base is not physical LAB

required_inputs.name: surface_boundary
required_inputs.authority: continental authored q class and TSurf scenario; positive-age ocean HWR-2 q(t); separate ridge T0 rule
required_inputs.rule: scenario IDs and exact support required; no global extrapolation

required_inputs.name: lower_model_boundary
required_inputs.authority: continental adiabat at authored model thickness or coupled HWR-2 basal pair on eligible ocean support
required_inputs.rule: do not label model-domain base as physical LAB; keep paired parameters coherent

required_inputs.name: material_property_tuple
required_inputs.authority: role-scoped B6N8-I specialist reference values and existing sensitivity ranges
required_inputs.units: k W m-1 K-1; rho kg m-3; Cp J kg-1 K-1
required_inputs.rule: support-role join first; derive kappa=k/(rho*Cp) from one coherent tuple

required_inputs.name: radiogenic_source_configuration
required_inputs.authority: role-scoped A_C/A_M reference values and existing sensitivity ranges
required_inputs.rule: explicit scenario binding; zero is not implicit; do not equate source with q or T(z)

required_inputs.name: ocean_age_adapter
required_inputs.authority: governed positive T0 ocean age plus B6N8-L deterministic material-column time adapter
required_inputs.rule: admitted positive-age ocean only; age remains positive; no ridge/unknown cells

required_inputs.name: scenario_and_recipe_identity
required_inputs.authority: versioned B6N8-J initializer, B6N8-K reduced model, B6N8-L adapter
required_inputs.rule: hash/identity includes parent field hashes, support IDs, property/source scenario IDs, boundary scenario IDs, time semantics and algorithm version

required_inputs.name: T0_thermal_initial_condition
required_inputs.meaning: Support-indexed T(z,T0) profile consumed as the initial condition for reduced thermal evolution from T0 to T1 PRE_EVENT. The profile may be generated by the selected initializer before evolution; this contract does not claim it already exists.
required_inputs.representation: Replayable profile payload T(z,T0) plus derivation/initializer identity and validity metadata, on explicitly admitted native support.
required_inputs.support: Same exact native support IDs, per-column material-role join, geometry and validity restrictions as the provider request; never globalized. Preserve 1072 unresolved positive-age ocean cells and 108 age-zero ridge cells outside the admitted temporal-provider path.
required_inputs.availability: NOT_AVAILABLE; no T0 profile has been generated
required_inputs.failure_semantics: If the required T0 profile/initializer output is unavailable, invalid, temporally misbound, or lacks an exact eligible support join, do not execute T0-to-T1 evolution; preserve UNKNOWN and fail closed. T1 PRE_EVENT, T1 POST_EVENT, or post-B6N1 state cannot substitute as the initial condition; no temporal backcasting.
required_inputs.readiness_semantics: INPUT_SCHEMA_COMPLETE does not imply INPUT_VALUES_AVAILABLE or PROVIDER_EXECUTABLE.

output_interface.state: candidate T(z,T1_PRE_EVENT) profile and associated diagnostics; not created by B6N8-L
output_interface.support: native source cell ID; no projection or section aggregation implied
output_interface.vertical_coordinate: declared depth datum and interface geometry with units; retain crust, model-base and thermal-LAB semantics separately
output_interface.material: role IDs and exact tuple/config identity per vertical layer; discrete IDs are not interpolated
output_interface.Buck_consumer: later B6N8-F adapter may consume profiles only after it governs section/support selection, sampling/aggregation, orientation and endpoint semantics

eligibility.age_zero_ridge_108: INELIGIBLE_FOR_T0_T1_TEMPORAL_PROVIDER pending ridge temporal authority; T0 effective-age profile index is not a history

failure_semantics.invalid_HWR_age_or_crossing: reject ocean column; do not clip/change q/age/geometry
failure_semantics.unsupported_temporal_semantics: return UNKNOWN; never convert to zero or no-change

acceptance_observables_for_next_stage.observable: temperature difference at explicitly authorized target depths
profile difference norm over common native vertical support
thermal contribution to the Buck force calculation on a later B6N8-F-selected section
acceptance_observables_for_next_stage.unit: must follow recovered Buck equation and governed section mapping
